stories.title: GTA fans are ditching work. "I literally just put GTA 6" in my PTO request, one worker said.
stories.summary: Some employees locked in their time off months ago, so they're free to start playing Grand Theft Auto 6 as soon as it launches on Nov. 19.

stories.title: Michigan Gov. Whitmer pardons her final turkey named "Sparty"
stories.summary: Michigan Gov. Gretchen Whitmer conducted the annual turkey-pardoning on Wednesday; this time, it's for a bird whose name honors the governor's alma mater.

stories.title: Roseville man charged with murder in shooting deaths of his parents
stories.summary: The suspect is due back in court in December for a probable cause conference.

stories.title: Angels acquire infielder Jace Jung in a trade with the Tigers for cash
stories.summary: The Los Angeles Angels have acquired infielder Jace Jung from the Detroit Tigers for cash to give the 2022 first-round draft pick a fresh start.

stories.title: Detroit Health Department issues call to action after U.S. loses measles elimination status
stories.summary: Detroit Chief Public Health Officer and Director Ali Abazeed calls the loss a serious, preventable national setback.

stories.title: Detroit Health Department issues measles call to action
stories.summary: Earlier this week, the Pan American Health Organization announced that the U.S. lost its measles elimination status. Now, the Detroit Health Department is issuing a call to action.

stories.title: University of Michigan students react to Texas A&M's Trev Alberts named athletic director
stories.summary: The reported hiring is already generating discussion on campus, with some students optimistic about the future of Wolverine athletics under new leadership.

stories.title: Michigan reportedly hires new AD; students react
stories.summary: The University of Michigan may soon have a new leader overseeing its athletic department. The reported hiring is already generating discussion on campus, with some students optimistic about the future of Wolverine athletics under new leadership.

stories.title: Iran, U.S. exchange fire after Iran targets military base
stories.summary: Iran is expanding attacks on countries along the Persian Gulf Coast, including on U.S. facilities.

stories.title: Roseville man accused of killing parents charged
stories.summary: A 31-year-old Roseville man accused of killing his parents over the weekend has been charged.

stories.title: Investigators testify about search of man's home in Ashley Elkins murder trial
stories.summary: Wednesday was Day 3 of the trial against DeAndre Booker, who is accused of killing Warren mother Ashley Elkins. Elkins was last seen in January 2025, and her body has not been found.

stories.title: Detroit mayor celebrates end of sidewalk replacement backlog
stories.summary: Detroit Mayor Mary Sheffield celebrated the completion of a long-awaited backlog of sidewalk repairs.
